ChatGPT just lost its majority. The AI market will never look the same.

For the first time, ChatGPT's market share has fallen below 50%. Google's Gemini now holds 27.7%, and Anthropic's Claude commands 10.3%, according to Sensor Tower's latest State of AI Report.

This is not a story about one company losing ground. It is the signal that the AI platform market has permanently fragmented. No single provider will dominate the way ChatGPT did through 2024 and 2025.

What does this mean for business leaders? If your AI strategy is tied to one vendor, you are carrying concentration risk that the market itself has already moved past. The smartest executive teams are building abstraction layers — architectures that let them plug in the best model for each task without rebuilding from scratch.

Google is pushing Gemini into every surface it controls. Anthropic is winning trust in enterprise and safety-critical workflows. The competitive dynamics are shifting quarterly.
